title: Use accurate peer attribution for native relay refusal diagnostics in both directions
outcome: Use accurate peer attribution for native relay refusal diagnostics in both directions
acceptance: Native relay refusal codes/advice identify the refusing peer accurately for both home read/ACK calls and Wake/InspectWake calls to the native host, with documentation matching the chosen direction-neutral or operation-specific convention.
Behavioral coverage witnesses safe authenticated persistence/capacity refusals in both directions while preserving original status, MAC, authority, retry and outcome classification.
